description: Live second-hand listings from OfferUp or Craigslist in the United States. Searches by keyword and location and returns title, price, location, posting time, link and image, plus description, condition and category where shown. Suited to second-hand price checks, deal finding and resale research. $0.02 per call, up to 25 listings.

category.description: A category of the chosen site. craigslist: sss (for sale, default), cta (cars & trucks), hhh (housing), apa (apartments for rent), rea, roo, sub, jjj (jobs), ggg (gigs), bbb (services), fua (furniture), ela (electronics), bia (bicycles), mca (motorcycles), zip (free). offerup: electronics-and-media,

details.description: craigslist only (default false): open every listing for its description and condition. Slower. offerup always includes them.

location.description: Where to search. offerup: a US city ("Austin, TX") or a 5-digit ZIP code (98101). craigslist: one of its city sites: sfbay, newyork, losangeles, chicago, seattle, austin, boston, denver ... (or the name, e.g. "SF bay area", or a sub-area such as manhattan). Craigslist does not take a ZIP code here:

query.description: Search words, up to 100 characters, e.g. "road bike". Optional: without it you get the listings of the location and category.

radius.description: Distance in miles. offerup: 5, 10, 20, 30 (default 30). craigslist: 1 to 500, only together with zip.

zip.description: craigslist only: search around this 5-digit ZIP code inside the city site; use radius for the distance.

name: classifieds_search
title: Live listings on OfferUp or Craigslist
